headline: OpenAI is planning a post-election policy blitz to align with the new Washington, as ChinaTalk examined what Korea's $1 trillion stock crash means for the global AI race and SemiAnalysis introduced a frontier benchmark spanning cyber, bio and chip-design domains.

points.text: Axios reported that OpenAI will launch a policy and PR blitz right after Tuesday's midterms to align with the new Washington, including an effort to rebrand data centers as 'AI compute campuses.'
ChinaTalk examined what Korea's $1 trillion stock market crash means for the global AI race.
SemiAnalysis introduced GDPx, a frontier benchmark measuring model capabilities across domains including RSI, hardware design, cyber, bio, chip design, and alignment.
SemiAnalysis reported that the datacenter backlash has gone bipartisan ahead of next week's midterms, with a prolonged Texas permit freeze now the biggest single risk to the 2028 US AI buildout.
